say:2:1410451001:0.text: Xera, halt! Come here and rectify this at once!
say:2:1410451001:0.source_cn: 席蕾，你站住！快来给我解决事情！

say:3:1410451002:1.source_cn: 哦……女王在上，怎么又是他……

say:4:1410451003:1.text: *Ahem* Lord Valvaris, how may I assist you?
say:4:1410451003:1.source_cn: 咳——拉瑟隆大人，有何吩咐？

say:5:1410451004:1.text: A lowborn dared to flee during my midday rest! This is a blatant insult! An affront to my honor!
say:5:1410451004:1.source_cn: 一个仆从竟然趁我午憩之时逃跑！这是活生生的挑衅！是践踏...

say:6:1410451005:0.text: You will find her and bring her back immediately! I shall cleanse this disgrace with her blood!
say:6:1410451005:0.source_cn: 你们得把她抓回来，立刻！马上！我要用她的鲜血洗刷耻辱！

say:8:1410451007:0.text: I shall adorn my gates with a fitting new trophy... perhaps the head of a commoner guard!
say:8:1410451007:0.source_cn: 我会用新的装饰品……比如，这个平民卫兵的脑袋来点缀我家大门！

say:10:1410451008:1.text: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.
say:10:1410451008:1.source_cn: 拉瑟隆又来了，这事可不是一次两次了。
say:10:1410451008:1.male: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.
say:10:1410451008:1.female: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.

choice_prompt:11:1410451008.text: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.
choice_prompt:11:1410451008.source_cn: 拉瑟隆又来了，这事可不是一次两次了。
choice_prompt:11:1410451008.male: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.
choice_prompt:11:1410451008.female: It's him again. This is hardly the first time.

say:12:1410451009:0.text: We've helped him complete tasks, but... those who were returned... well, I trust you can imagine their unfortunate end.
say:12:1410451009:0.source_cn: 我们完成了任务，但被抓回来的人……你一定能想象他们的下场。
say:12:1410451009:0.male: We've helped him complete tasks, but... those who were returned... well, I trust you can imagine their unfortunate end.
say:12:1410451009:0.female: We've helped him complete tasks, but... those who were returned... well, I trust you can imagine their unfortunate end.

say:13:1410451011:1.text: I suspect I know where she's hiding. This will be a simple task. Let's proceed.
say:13:1410451011:1.source_cn: 我大概知道她躲在哪里。这是个简单的练手任务，走吧。
say:13:1410451011:1.male: I suspect I know where she's hiding. This will be a simple task. Let's proceed.
say:13:1410451011:1.female: I suspect I know where she's hiding. This will be a simple task. Let's proceed.

say:15:1410451010:0.text: Indeed. They are simply victims of an unjust master.
say:15:1410451010:0.source_cn: 是啊，他们命运不济，摊上这样的主人。
say:15:1410451010:0.male: Indeed. They are simply victims of an unjust master.
say:15:1410451010:0.female: Indeed. They are simply victims of an unjust master.

say:0:1410451101:0.text: Help! Help! Save me! I'll never run away again!
say:0:1410451101:0.source_cn: 救命啊！救命！大人，救救我！我再也不会跑了！
say:0:1410451101:0.male: Help! Help! Save me! I'll never run away again!
say:0:1410451101:0.female: Help! Help! Save me! I'll never run away again!

say:1:1410451102:0.text: There's a corrupted Essail nearby! We need to save her!
say:1:1410451102:0.source_cn: 这里竟然会有孽化者！待会再说，先把她救下！
say:1:1410451102:0.male: There's a corrupted Essail nearby! We need to save her!
say:1:1410451102:0.female: There's a corrupted Essail nearby! We need to save her!

say:2:1410452001:0.text: I never meant any harm! It was an accident, I swear!
say:2:1410452001:0.source_cn: 我不是有意冒犯的！我发誓是意外！

say:3:1410452002:0.text: I just... I accidentally saw my master remove his veil...
say:3:1410452002:0.source_cn: 我只是……只是不小心看到主人摘下面纱……

choice_prompt:4:1410452002.text: I just... I accidentally saw my master remove his veil...
choice_prompt:4:1410452002.source_cn: 我只是……只是不小心看到主人摘下面纱……

say:5:1410452003:0.text: It was... it was something strange, like <style="highlight">scales</style>...
say:5:1410452003:0.male: It was... it was something strange, like <style="highlight">scales</style>...
say:5:1410452003:0.female: It was... it was something strange, like <style="highlight">scales</style>...

say:6:1410452004:0.text: No! I saw nothing! I swear!
say:6:1410452004:0.male: No! I saw nothing! I swear!
say:6:1410452004:0.female: No! I saw nothing! I swear!

say:7:1410452005:1.text: Calm yourself. Speak truthfully, and perhaps your punishment can be lessened.
say:7:1410452005:1.source_cn: 冷静点，告诉我们实情，也许能减轻你的处罚。

say:8:1410452006:0.text: You don't understand... I swear! I saw nothing! I didn't speak a word!
say:8:1410452006:0.source_cn: 您不明白……总之，我什么都没看见！什么都没说！

say:9:1410452007:1.text: *Sigh* Very well. I'll hand you over to the priests.
say:9:1410452007:1.source_cn: 唉，既然如此，那我就把你交给祭司大人们吧。

choice_prompt:10:1410452007.text: *Sigh* Very well. I'll hand you over to the priests.
choice_prompt:10:1410452007.source_cn: 唉，既然如此，那我就把你交给祭司大人们吧。

say:11:1410452008:1.text: ... I refuse to let history repeat itself.
say:11:1410452008:1.male: ... I refuse to let history repeat itself.
say:11:1410452008:1.female: ... I refuse to let history repeat itself.

say:12:1410452010:1.text: The law gives the priests ultimate authority in matters of punishment.
say:12:1410452010:1.source_cn: 律法规定祭司大人们的判决至高无上，任何人都无权干涉。所以……
say:12:1410452010:1.male: The law gives the priests ultimate authority in matters of punishment.
say:12:1410452010:1.female: The law gives the priests ultimate authority in matters of punishment.

say:13:1410452011:0.text: Thus, I will entrust this lowborn to the priests. Valvaris will accept the outcome...
say:13:1410452011:0.source_cn: 我会将这个仆从交给祭司大人，不过你放心……拉瑟隆会接受...
say:13:1410452011:0.male: Thus, I will entrust this lowborn to the priests. Valvaris will accept the outcome...
say:13:1410452011:0.female: Thus, I will entrust this lowborn to the priests. Valvaris will accept the outcome...

say:14:1410452012:1.text: And fear not. He would never dare harm you. Let's go visit the priests.
say:14:1410452012:1.source_cn: 当然了，拉瑟隆也不敢对你怎么样的。走吧，我们去见祭司大人们。
say:14:1410452012:1.male: And fear not. He would never dare harm you. Let's go visit the priests.
say:14:1410452012:1.female: And fear not. He would never dare harm you. Let's go visit the priests.

say:16:1410452009:1.text: Legally, Valvaris is her owner, but not her judge.
say:16:1410452009:1.source_cn: 从律法而言，他的主人只有所有权，并非处罚权。
say:16:1410452009:1.male: Legally, Valvaris is her owner, but not her judge.
say:16:1410452009:1.female: Legally, Valvaris is her owner, but not her judge.

choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 为什么要跳过他的主人？

say:2:1410453001:0.text: Ma'am, this lowborn belongs to Lord Valvaris. She has unintentionally offended him. We seek your fair judgment.
say:2:1410453001:0.source_cn: 祭司大人，这是拉瑟隆大人的仆从，她无意中冒犯了主人。请...

say:3:1410453002:0.text: In the name of the Queen, we shall mark this soul with a Stigma of Judgment and banish her from the royal city. May the Queen's brilliance guide your path.
say:3:1410453002:0.source_cn: 以女王之名，我们会对此人降下惩罚印记并从王城中驱逐。愿...

choice_prompt:5:1410453002.text: In the name of the Queen, we shall mark this soul with a Stigma of Judgment and banish her from the royal city. May the Queen's brilliance guide your path.
choice_prompt:5:1410453002.source_cn: 以女王之名，我们会对此人惩罚印记并从王城中驱逐。愿女王的光辉永远照耀你们。

say:6:1410453003:1.text: She's already been handed to the priests for judgment. What can he say to that?
say:6:1410453003:1.source_cn: 已经转交祭司大人责罚了，他能说什么？
say:6:1410453003:1.male: She's already been handed to the priests for judgment. What can he say to that?
say:6:1410453003:1.female: She's already been handed to the priests for judgment. What can he say to that?

say:7:1410453005:1.text: Ah, I see that look in your eyes. Are you worried about my safety? Fear not, His Highness Ravion will handle things. Now, let's move on to our next task.
say:7:1410453005:1.source_cn: 你那眼神，该不是在担心我的安危吧？沙利叶殿下会处理好的...
say:7:1410453005:1.male: Ah, I see that look in your eyes. Are you worried about my safety? Fear not, His Highness Ravion will handle things. Now, let's move on to our next task.
say:7:1410453005:1.female: Ah, I see that look in your eyes. Are you worried about my safety? Fear not, His Highness Ravion will handle things. Now, let's move on to our next task.

say:8:1410453006:0.text: Rest assured, His Highness tacitly supports our actions. Without his approval, we could never defy such nobles.
say:8:1410453006:0.source_cn: 放心好了，沙利叶殿下默许我们的所作所为。否则以我们的职...
say:8:1410453006:0.male: Rest assured, His Highness tacitly supports our actions. Without his approval, we could never defy such nobles.
say:8:1410453006:0.female: Rest assured, His Highness tacitly supports our actions. Without his approval, we could never defy such nobles.

choice_prompt:9:1410453006.text: Rest assured, His Highness tacitly supports our actions. Without his approval, we could never defy such nobles.
choice_prompt:9:1410453006.source_cn: 放心好了，沙利叶殿下默许我们的所作所为。否则以我们的职权，又怎么敢忤逆这些贵族呢？
choice_prompt:9:1410453006.male: Rest assured, His Highness tacitly supports our actions. Without his approval, we could never defy such nobles.
choice_prompt:9:1410453006.female: Rest assured, His Highness tacitly supports our actions. Without his approval, we could never defy such nobles.

say:10:1410453007:1.text: Hmm... it's best not to speculate on His Highness' intentions...
say:10:1410453007:1.source_cn: 嗯……我们不能贸然揣测那位大人的心思……
say:10:1410453007:1.male: Hmm... it's best not to speculate on His Highness' intentions...
say:10:1410453007:1.female: Hmm... it's best not to speculate on His Highness' intentions...

say:11:1410453008:0.text: But compared to other nobles, Prince Ravion is certainly more compassionate towards commoners and the lowborn.
say:11:1410453008:0.source_cn: 总之，与其他几位长老相比，沙利叶殿下对待平民与仆从的态...
say:11:1410453008:0.male: But compared to other nobles, Prince Ravion is certainly more compassionate towards commoners and the lowborn.
say:11:1410453008:0.female: But compared to other nobles, Prince Ravion is certainly more compassionate towards commoners and the lowborn.

say:12:1410453009:0.text: That's why I chose to align with him. Captain Indris likely feels the same way.
say:12:1410453009:0.source_cn: 这也是我选择与沙利叶殿下为伍的理由，我猜，因度厄卫队长...
say:12:1410453009:0.male: That's why I chose to align with him. Captain Indris likely feels the same way.
say:12:1410453009:0.female: That's why I chose to align with him. Captain Indris likely feels the same way.

say:13:1410453010:1.text: Now that you've joined the guard, it's crucial to judge right and wrong with your own eyes.
say:13:1410453010:1.source_cn: 你既然选择加入卫队，还是用自己的双眼去辨别是非曲直吧。
say:13:1410453010:1.male: Now that you've joined the guard, it's crucial to judge right and wrong with your own eyes.
say:13:1410453010:1.female: Now that you've joined the guard, it's crucial to judge right and wrong with your own eyes.

say:14:1410453011:1.text: There's no time to linger. We have other duties to attend to. Let's go.
say:14:1410453011:1.source_cn: 好啦。我们还有任务，不能再耽搁了，快走吧。
say:14:1410453011:1.male: There's no time to linger. We have other duties to attend to. Let's go.
say:14:1410453011:1.female: There's no time to linger. We have other duties to attend to. Let's go.

say:16:1410453004:1.text: Protect? What are you implying? This is the law. I'm merely adhering to it.
say:16:1410453004:1.source_cn: 保护？ 你在说什么呢。这是律法，我遵照律法办事又有什么问题？
say:16:1410453004:1.male: Protect? What are you implying? This is the law. I'm merely adhering to it.
say:16:1410453004:1.female: Protect? What are you implying? This is the law. I'm merely adhering to it.

choice:5:1:2.text: Do you want to protect her?
choice:5:1:2.male: Do you want to protect her?
choice:5:1:2.female: Do you want to protect her?
